title: fix(compaction): keep required facts when fitting a dense summary to the request budget
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes safeguard compaction canceling with “required facts exceed the finalized summary budget” when a CJK-heavy summary can fit after trimming optional prose. The preserved history otherwise sends the next turn into the same failure.

Related: #119272, #130393.

## User Impact

Small-context sessions can retain required requests and identifiers while compacting mixed-script summaries. Truly unaffordable required facts still cancel compaction and preserve history. No configuration, dependency, persistence-cap, or token-estimator changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared fitter searches summary character budgets, then applies the existing CJK-aware estimate. Below the required-fact minimum, the safeguard used to return a dense head cut that dropped those facts. Its higher token cost could exclude larger candidates that actually fit. The producer now reports that candidate as too small through the fitter’s existing contract; the redundant later rejection path is removed.

Thanks to @amittell for the original fix and investigation. Contributor commits are preserved, with current main merged into the branch. The final diff removes the obsolete persistence-cap test and unrelated helper relocation: production +6/-11, tests +94/-20, docs +3/-1 relative to the merged main head.

## Evidence

- Baseline `cb3af7ea2588c0b4dd67b33331e2d2265bb2a556`: the regression cancels with ordinary Chinese prose and an affordable ASCII request at a 1,000-token summary budget. The candidate retains the request within that budget. All 75 focused tests pass; the new budget file has 3 tests, 49 ms of test time and 38.93 s wall time including worker preparation. The other 3 files take 29.17 s wall time. On exact-head CI, the budget file passes in 50 ms of tests, 3.83 s Vitest duration, and 5.12 s runner time; the existing safeguard file passes in 8.33 s runner time.
- Independent Codex autoreview: scoped clean, no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Max-lines, line-cap, assertion-safety, timeout-race, mock-export, config-doc, and plugin-inventory checks passed.
- Static prompt text is unchanged (prompt token delta: 0).

Live proof used native Ollama `qwen3:8b` through `pnpm openclaw --profile compaction-cjk agent --local --agent main --session-key agent:main:cjk-unmetered --message-file <fixture> --thinking off --json`. The fixture is synthetic, unmetered CJK history with three long manifest paths and a 24,900-character pending message. OpenClaw's context budget is 16,384; the existing `params.num_ctx: 9800`, `truncate: false`, and `shift: false` settings cause a real local-server overflow (the server reports an effective 9,984-token window). A transparent loopback proxy records native requests and responses without modifying them.

Main receives that overflow, calls Qwen3 for the summary, then cancels with “required facts exceed the finalized summary budget” (48.2 s; no stored compaction). The candidate recovers with one compaction, persists 2,789 characters at 920.75 tokens using the shared estimate, retains all three manifest paths, and retries successfully (67.3 s). A fresh CLI turn returns all three paths again (7.9 s). Production proof was run at `2649134e78c1637ef6980ce898dbed79b5d557c0`; subsequent changes only relocate tests and merge main without changing the compaction owner.

Both full builds, targeted lint, core typechecking, and the agents-other test type graph pass. The first broader changed-file check exposed main's pre-existing UI type-graph root limit; this branch merges the upstream repair `471035c7b7c8` through main `3e44be0fb8a60c7ea98a38aa7cf9f50faf7abbd8`. The final changed-file check passes all selected ratchets and all 28 core test type graphs, then stops on two inherited export-scan findings: `tools/solid-lint/index.mjs: default` and `ui/src/test-helpers/solid-application-context.tsx: hiddenScopeUpgradeCapability`. Both reproduce in a separate checkout of main `3e44be0fb8a6` without this patch. Targeted lint and typechecks pass separately. The required `openclaw/ci-gate` is successful on `2ca44db7a3cfd0f0fe4bb1d0e93b2655e33d4144` ([run 38078892674](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38078892674)). ClawSweeper reviewed that same head with no findings, no before-merge items, and sufficient live proof ([review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138416#issuecomment-5544317262)). This PR is ready for maintainer review; it has not been merged.
